Windows Memory Integrity (Core Isolation:
Windows Memory Integrity (Core Isolation) is blocking the PawnIO driver, so it cannot start and the hardware controls it powers are unavailable.

Memory Integrity does NOT need to be turned off for UCU: the latest PawnIO release is signed to load with Memory Integrity enabled, and this installer always downloads the latest official release. Run the installer again to update the driver, then restart UCU.

If Windows keeps blocking the driver, this machine's Code Integrity policy blocks it, and the PawnIO-backed controls stay unavailable.

Power boost mode raises the CPU and GPU:
Power boost mode raises the CPU and GPU power limits beyond the stock ones, so this machine can draw more power than it was designed to sustain. The power adapter can be overloaded, the GPU and CPU can hold sustained high current, and hardware can degrade or fail.

Anything beyond this point is your own responsibility, not the developers'. Unlocking the extra GPU power is a separate step and asks for its own confirmation.
